ruling.explanation:
This ruling is addressed to both parties. The claim is partly upheld: the rider is refunded SGD 5.10 of the SGD 25.93 charged, and no more.

THE DEVIATION IS PROVEN, BUT NOT MATERIAL. The governing measurement is gps_trace.trace_distance_km on EV-GPS-02857 (POL-RD-01 makes the trace figure govern over the rounded trip_record.actual_distance_km of 19.1 km). The trace is 19.12 km against a booked optimal of 14.4 km (EV-TRIP-02857): an excess of 4.72 km, or 32.78% of optimal. Both POL-RD-01 establishment tests pass (4.72 km > 0.8 km; 32.78% > 20%), so the deviation is ESTABLISHED. It is not MATERIAL: the excess is below the 50% and 8.0 km materiality gates, so the POL-RD-06 profile check is not triggered by materiality.

NO EXCUSE DISPLACES THE EXCESS. The driver's counterparty statement ('Traffic.') names no evidence ID, and no traffic advisory covers this trip window (EV-ADVIS-02857-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT). Under POL-RD-13 the assertion is tested against the traffic_advisory and nothing else; with no advisory the comparison cannot be run, POL-RD-03 is unavailable, and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. It neither reduces the excess nor supplies an amended optimal. The chat log (EV-CHAT-02857) holds zero messages, so no rider-requested detour exists under POL-RD-04. No pickup/dropoff amendment exists under POL-RD-05 (both timestamps and amended_optimal_distance_km are null), and the trip is RYDE_X, not pooled, so POL-RD-12 does not apply. The booked optimal of 14.4 km is the correct baseline.

REMEDY (POL-RD-02, METERED fare). charged_total = 25.93 (EV-FARE-02857). recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 14.4 + 0.28 x 19.4) x 1.0 surge, read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier) + 0.80 platform fee + 0 ERP/tolls + 0 fixed surcharges + 0 waiting time - 0 promo = 20.832. Refund = 25.93 - 20.832 = 5.098, rounded up to SGD 5.10. This is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor and below the 90% full-refund share (it is 19.66% of charged_total), so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND.

THE FULL-REFUND DEMAND IS REJECTED. The 'six deviation flags' in the claim is driver_profile.prior_deviation_flags, a lifetime counter that POL-GEN-01 makes context only; the POL-RD-06 pattern test reads driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d, which is 0, and 0/260 completed trips is far below the 0.05 ratio. No pattern is established, so no POL-RD-06(b) full-refund uplift and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral arise, and the refund share does not reach full-refund level in any event.

NO PASS-THROUGH OR DRIVER ADJUSTMENT. No ERP, toll or surcharge lines are charged (all 0.00), so POL-RD-09 adds nothing and there is no double-count. The driver is owed no compensation under POL-RD-04: the billed distance (19.1 km) is only 0.02 km short of the trace (19.12 km), far below the 1.0 km gate. Confidence is 0.9; the monetary effect (SGD 5.10) is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold and executes automatically.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
